title: Cross-Stack Standard allowlist
description: A dated allowlist for one rule, stored as .cross-stack/allowlists/<RULE-ID>.json. Every entry needs a reason, an owner and an expiry date; expired entries fail the check.

$schema.description: URL of this schema, for editor completion.

rule.description: The ID of the rule the entries apply to (a track prefix and three digits); it must match the file name.

match.description: What the entry allows, in the form the rule's gate documents (for example a project-relative path or glob).

expires.description: The last day (UTC, YYYY-MM-DD) on which the entry is valid.

owner.description: Who removes the entry: a GitHub handle, team or email address.
